<!-- Shared dashboard implementation. index.qmd and fr/index.qmd provide
     site_lang and site_root; all summaries and table rows come from corpus.csv. -->

```{r}
source(file.path(site_root, "R", "site_i18n.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")
source(file.path(site_root, "R", "utils.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")
source(file.path(site_root, "R", "operational_board.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")
source(file.path(site_root, "R", "spatial_constellation.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")
L <- site_labels[[site_lang]]

# Data preparation -----------------------------------------------------------
read_or_empty <- function(path) if (file.exists(path)) read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA")) else data.frame()
docs <- read_or_empty(file.path(site_root, "data", "corpus.csv"))
engagements <- read_or_empty(file.path(site_root, "data", "engagements.csv"))
engagement_documents <- read_or_empty(file.path(site_root, "data", "engagement_documents.csv"))
engagement_instruments <- read_or_empty(file.path(site_root, "data", "engagement_instruments.csv"))
spatial_review <- read_or_empty(file.path(site_root, "data", "spatial_review_queue.csv"))
required_columns <- c("document_id", "version_id", "title", "year", "publication_date", "page_last_modified",
  "event_start_date", "event_end_date", "institution", "families", "language", "document_type",
  "operation_name", "international_mission_name", "matched_concepts", "document_url",
  "concept_coding_state", "official_alternate_urls", "relevance_excerpt", "review_status", "format")
for (nm in setdiff(required_columns, names(docs))) docs[[nm]] <- NA_character_
if (!nrow(docs)) docs <- docs[FALSE, required_columns, drop = FALSE]

split_long <- function(values, ids) {
  out <- lapply(seq_along(values), function(i) {
    z <- strsplit(ifelse(is.na(values[i]), "", values[i]), "\\|")[[1]]
    z <- trimws(z)
    z <- z[!is.na(z) & nzchar(z)]
    if (!length(z) || !present(ids[i])) return(NULL)
    data.frame(id = rep(ids[i], length(z)), value = z)
  })
  out <- Filter(Negate(is.null), out)
  if (!length(out)) data.frame(id = character(), value = character()) else unique(do.call(rbind, out))
}

present <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))
safe_min <- function(x) if (length(x <- x[!is.na(x)])) min(x) else "—"
safe_max <- function(x) if (length(x <- x[!is.na(x)])) max(x) else "—"
label_text <- function(x) {
  site_term(x, site_lang)
}
empty_note <- function(text) cat(sprintf('<p class="empty-state">%s</p>', text))

analytical_docs <- docs[present(docs$document_id), , drop = FALSE]
allowed_concept_states <- c("confirmed", "pending_review", "reviewed_no_confirmed_concept", "no_configured_match")
if (any(!analytical_docs$concept_coding_state %in% allowed_concept_states)) {
  stop("Invalid or blank concept_coding_state in active corpus")
}
doc_years <- unique(analytical_docs[!is.na(analytical_docs$year), c("document_id", "year"), drop = FALSE])
doc_institutions <- unique(analytical_docs[present(analytical_docs$institution), c("document_id", "institution"), drop = FALSE])
fam <- split_long(analytical_docs$families, analytical_docs$document_id)
confirmed_docs <- analytical_docs[analytical_docs$concept_coding_state == "confirmed", , drop = FALSE]
pending_concept_docs <- unique(analytical_docs$document_id[analytical_docs$concept_coding_state == "pending_review"])
reviewed_no_confirmed_docs <- unique(analytical_docs$document_id[analytical_docs$concept_coding_state == "reviewed_no_confirmed_concept"])
no_configured_match_docs <- unique(analytical_docs$document_id[analytical_docs$concept_coding_state == "no_configured_match"])
concept_denominator_docs <- analytical_docs[analytical_docs$concept_coding_state != "pending_review", , drop = FALSE]
concept_denominator_years <- unique(concept_denominator_docs[!is.na(concept_denominator_docs$year), c("document_id", "year"), drop = FALSE])
con <- split_long(confirmed_docs$matched_concepts, confirmed_docs$document_id)
period_levels <- c("1991–1995", "1996–2000", "2001–2005", "2006–2010", "2011–2015", "2016–2020", "2021–2026")
period_label <- if (site_lang == "fr") "Période" else "Period"
period_from_year <- function(year) {
  cut(year, breaks = c(1991, 1996, 2001, 2006, 2011, 2016, 2021, 2027),
    right = FALSE, labels = period_levels)
}
check_bilingual_consistency(analytical_docs, doc_years, doc_institutions, fam, con, docs)

navy <- "#17324d"
blue <- "#527a95"
red <- "#a44747"
grid <- "#dfe5e8"
plot_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = navy),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = grid, linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#51606b"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 10, 8, 4)
  )

# Plot rendering -------------------------------------------------------------
interactive_plot <- function(p) {
  widget <- plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", dynamicTicks = FALSE)
  widget <- plotly::config(widget, displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
  plotly::layout(widget, autosize = TRUE, hoverlabel = list(align = "left"))
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
cat('</div>')
```

```{=html}
<noscript><style>.operation-brief[hidden]{display:grid}</style></noscript>
<script>
// The board expects operation dots with matching briefing articles. Native
// links and all briefing content remain available without JavaScript; this
// enhancement keeps only one detail fiche open at a time and filters the
// validated engagement identities already encoded in the rendered markup.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-operational-board]').forEach(board => {
    const triggers = [...board.querySelectorAll('[data-operation-target]')];
    const briefs = [...board.querySelectorAll('.operation-brief')];
    const layers = [...board.querySelectorAll('[data-engagement-layer]')];
    const connectors = [...board.querySelectorAll('.engagement-layer-link')];
    const filters = [...board.querySelectorAll('[data-engagement-filter]')];
    const allFilter = filters.find(filter => filter.dataset.engagementFilter === 'all');
    const categoryFilters = filters.filter(filter => filter !== allFilter);
    const briefsById = new Map(briefs.map(brief => [brief.id, brief]));
    const briefHomes = new Map(briefs.map(brief => [brief, {
      parent: brief.parentNode,
      next: brief.nextSibling
    }]));
    const visiblePlotRect = () => {
      const scrollRect = board.querySelector('.simple-timeline-scroll').getBoundingClientRect();
      const trackRects = layers
        .filter(layer => !layer.hidden)
        .map(layer => layer.querySelector('.engagement-layer-track').getBoundingClientRect());
      return {
        top: Math.max(scrollRect.top, Math.min(...trackRects.map(rect => rect.top))),
        right: Math.min(scrollRect.right, Math.max(...trackRects.map(rect => rect.right))),
        bottom: Math.min(scrollRect.bottom, Math.max(...trackRects.map(rect => rect.bottom))),
        left: Math.max(scrollRect.left, Math.min(...trackRects.map(rect => rect.left)))
      };
    };
    const positionBrief = (brief, trigger) => {
      const triggerRect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
      const plotRect = visiblePlotRect();
      const gap = 14;
      const edge = 14;
      const briefWidth = Math.min(640, window.innerWidth - (edge * 2));
      brief.style.width = `${briefWidth}px`;
      const briefRect = brief.getBoundingClientRect();
      const centeredLeft = triggerRect.left + (triggerRect.width / 2) - (briefRect.width / 2);
      const left = Math.max(edge, Math.min(
        centeredLeft,
        window.innerWidth - edge - briefRect.width
      ));
      const above = triggerRect.top - gap - briefRect.height;
      const placeAbove = above >= plotRect.top + edge;
      const preferredTop = placeAbove
        ? above
        : triggerRect.bottom + gap;
      const top = Math.max(edge, Math.min(
        preferredTop,
        window.innerHeight - edge - briefRect.height
      ));
      brief.style.left = `${left}px`;
      brief.style.top = `${top}px`;
    };
    const restoreBrief = brief => {
      const home = briefHomes.get(brief);
      if (brief.parentNode !== home.parent) {
        const next = home.next?.parentNode === home.parent ? home.next : null;
        home.parent.insertBefore(brief, next);
      }
      brief.classList.remove('is-viewport-overlay');
      brief.style.removeProperty('left');
      brief.style.removeProperty('top');
      brief.style.removeProperty('width');
      delete brief.dataset.positioning;
    };
    const closeAll = () => {
      triggers.forEach(trigger => trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      briefs.forEach(brief => {
        brief.hidden = true;
        restoreBrief(brief);
      });
      board.classList.remove('has-selection');
    };
    triggers.forEach(trigger => trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = briefsById.get(trigger.dataset.operationTarget);
      const wasOpen = trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      closeAll();
      if (!wasOpen && target) {
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        document.body.appendChild(target);
        target.classList.add('is-viewport-overlay');
        target.dataset.positioning = 'true';
        target.hidden = false;
        board.classList.add('has-selection');
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') return;
          positionBrief(target, trigger);
          delete target.dataset.positioning;
          target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }));
      }
    }));
    board.querySelectorAll('[data-close-brief]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const openTrigger = triggers.find(trigger => trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true');
        closeAll();
        openTrigger?.focus();
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;
      const openTrigger = triggers.find(trigger => trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true');
      if (!openTrigger) return;
      closeAll();
      openTrigger.focus();
    });
    const showAll = () => {
      layers.forEach(layer => { layer.hidden = false; });
      connectors.forEach(connector => { connector.hidden = false; });
      filters.forEach(filter => {
        const active = filter.dataset.engagementFilter === 'all';
        filter.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
        filter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
      });
    };
    filters.forEach(filter => filter.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const category = filter.dataset.engagementFilter;
      if (category === 'all') {
        closeAll();
        showAll();
        return;
      }
      const showingAll = allFilter.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
      if (showingAll) {
        categoryFilters.forEach(candidate => candidate.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'));
        filter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      } else {
        filter.setAttribute(
          'aria-pressed',
          String(filter.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true')
        );
      }
      const activeCategories = categoryFilters
        .filter(candidate => candidate.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true')
        .map(candidate => candidate.dataset.engagementFilter);
      if (!activeCategories.length || activeCategories.length === categoryFilters.length) {
        closeAll();
        showAll();
        return;
      }
      allFilter.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      filters.forEach(candidate => {
        candidate.classList.toggle('is-active', candidate.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true');
      });
      layers.forEach(layer => {
        layer.hidden = !activeCategories.includes(layer.dataset.engagementLayer);
      });
      connectors.forEach(connector => {
        const categories = connector.dataset.instrumentCategories.split('|');
        const visibleRows = layers
          .filter(layer => !layer.hidden)
          .map(layer => layer.dataset.engagementLayer);
        const linkedRows = categories
          .filter(value => activeCategories.includes(value))
          .map(value => visibleRows.indexOf(value) + 1)
          .filter(index => index > 0);
        connector.hidden = linkedRows.length < 2;
        if (!connector.hidden) {
          connector.style.setProperty('--link-top', `${(Math.min(...linkedRows) - 0.5) * 88}px`);
          connector.style.setProperty('--link-height', `${(Math.max(...linkedRows) - Math.min(...linkedRows)) * 88}px`);
        }
      });
      const openTrigger = triggers.find(trigger => trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true');
      const openCategories = openTrigger?.closest('.simple-operation')
        ?.dataset.instrumentCategories.split('|') ?? [];
      if (openTrigger && !openCategories.some(value => activeCategories.includes(value))) closeAll();
    }));
    const requested = location.hash.slice(1);
    const requestedTrigger = triggers.find(trigger => trigger.dataset.operationTarget === requested);
    if (requestedTrigger) requestedTrigger.click();
    let repositionFrame = null;
    const repositionOpenBrief = () => {
      if (repositionFrame !== null) return;
      repositionFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        repositionFrame = null;
        const openTrigger = triggers.find(trigger => trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true');
        if (!openTrigger) return;
        const target = briefsById.get(openTrigger.dataset.operationTarget);
        if (target) positionBrief(target, openTrigger);
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', repositionOpenBrief);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', repositionOpenBrief, true);
  });
});
</script>
```

## `r L$problematizations_heading`

```{r}
concept_years <- merge(con, doc_years, by.x = "id", by.y = "document_id")
if (nrow(concept_years)) {
  concept_years$period <- period_from_year(concept_years$year)
  concept_counts <- aggregate(id ~ period + value, unique(concept_years[c("id", "period", "value")]), length)
  names(concept_counts)[3] <- "count"
  period_denominators <- aggregate(document_id ~ period, unique(transform(concept_denominator_years, period = period_from_year(year))[c("document_id", "period")]), length)
  names(period_denominators)[2] <- "period_total"
  complete_grid <- expand.grid(period = period_levels, value = unique(concept_years$value), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  concept_counts <- merge(complete_grid, concept_counts, by = c("period", "value"), all.x = TRUE)
  concept_counts <- merge(concept_counts, period_denominators, by = "period", all.x = TRUE)
  concept_counts$count[is.na(concept_counts$count)] <- 0L
  concept_counts$period_total[is.na(concept_counts$period_total)] <- 0L
  concept_counts$percentage <- ifelse(concept_counts$period_total > 0, 100 * concept_counts$count / concept_counts$period_total, NA_real_)
  concept_counts$period <- factor(concept_counts$period, levels = period_levels)
  concept_counts$concept <- label_text(concept_counts$value)
  concept_counts$tooltip <- ifelse(
    concept_counts$period_total > 0,
    paste0(L$concept, ": ", concept_counts$concept, "<br>", period_label, ": ", concept_counts$period, "<br>", L$documents, ": ", concept_counts$count, " / ", concept_counts$period_total, "<br>", sprintf("%.1f%%", concept_counts$percentage)),
    paste0(L$concept, ": ", concept_counts$concept, "<br>", period_label, ": ", concept_counts$period, "<br>", L$no_dated_period)
  )
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(concept_counts, ggplot2::aes(period, concept, fill = percentage,
    text = tooltip)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "#f8f6f1", linewidth = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef3f5", high = navy) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = L$analytical_concept, fill = "%") +
    plot_theme
  interactive_plot(p)
} else empty_note(L$no_concepts)
```

## `r L$institutions_instruments_heading`

```{r results='asis'}
instrument_labels <- list(
  en = c(military = "Military operation", police = "Police mission or training", defence = "Defence policy or strategy", parliament = "Parliamentary debate, evidence or report", development = "Development program or evaluation", diplomacy = "Diplomatic statement or readout", sanctions = "Sanction or regulation", finance = "Public-finance or expenditure instrument"),
  fr = c(military = "Opération militaire", police = "Mission ou formation policière", defence = "Politique ou stratégie de défense", parliament = "Débat, témoignage ou rapport parlementaire", development = "Programme ou évaluation de développement", diplomacy = "Déclaration diplomatique ou compte rendu", sanctions = "Sanction ou règlement", finance = "Instrument de finances publiques ou de dépenses")
)
classify_instrument <- function(families, document_type, operation_name) {
  family_values <- tolower(trimws(unlist(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(families), "", families), "\\|"))))
  type <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(document_type), "", document_type))
  if (present(operation_name) || type == "operation_record") return("military")
  if ("rcmp" %in% family_values) return("police")
  if ("defence_policy" %in% family_values) return("defence")
  if ("parliament" %in% family_values) return("parliament")
  if ("development" %in% family_values) return("development")
  if ("sanctions" %in% family_values || type == "regulation") return("sanctions")
  if ("public_finance" %in% family_values) return("finance")
  if (any(family_values %in% c("statements", "regional_strategy")) || type %in% c("statement", "speech", "readout", "news_release")) return("diplomacy")
  ""
}
instrument_docs <- analytical_docs[!duplicated(analytical_docs$document_id), c("document_id", "institution", "families", "document_type", "operation_name"), drop = FALSE]
instrument_docs$instrument <- mapply(classify_instrument, instrument_docs$families, instrument_docs$document_type, instrument_docs$operation_name, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
instrument_docs <- merge(instrument_docs[present(instrument_docs$institution) & present(instrument_docs$instrument), ], doc_years, by = "document_id", all.x = TRUE)
instrument_docs$period <- as.character(period_from_year(instrument_docs$year))
matrix_periods <- c(L$full_period, period_levels)
matrix_keys <- c("all", period_levels)
cat(sprintf('<div class="instrument-matrix" data-instrument-matrix><label><span>%s</span><select class="form-select" data-matrix-period>', L$selected_period))
cat(paste(sprintf('<option value="matrix-%d">%s</option>', seq_along(matrix_periods), matrix_periods), collapse = ""))
cat('</select></label>')
for (period_index in seq_along(matrix_keys)) {
  key <- matrix_keys[period_index]
  subset <- if (key == "all") instrument_docs else instrument_docs[!is.na(instrument_docs$period) & instrument_docs$period == key, , drop = FALSE]
  counts <- if (nrow(subset)) aggregate(document_id ~ institution + instrument, unique(subset[c("document_id", "institution", "instrument")]), length) else data.frame(institution = character(), instrument = character(), document_id = integer())
  names(counts)[3] <- "count"
  institutions <- sort(unique(instrument_docs$institution))
  instruments <- names(instrument_labels[[site_lang]])
  maximum <- if (nrow(counts)) max(counts$count) else 1
  cat(sprintf('<div class="instrument-matrix-panel" id="matrix-%d"%s>', period_index, if (period_index == 1) "" else " hidden"))
  if (!nrow(subset) && key != "all") {
    cat(sprintf('<p class="empty-state">%s</p></div>', L$no_dated_period))
    next
  }
  cat(sprintf('<div class="matrix-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>%s</th>', L$institution))
  cat(paste(sprintf('<th>%s</th>', instrument_labels[[site_lang]][instruments]), collapse = ""), '</tr></thead><tbody>')
  for (institution in institutions) {
    institution_label <- localized_institution(institution, site_lang)
    cat(sprintf('<tr><th>%s</th>', institution_label))
    for (instrument in instruments) {
      matched <- counts$count[counts$institution == institution & counts$instrument == instrument]
      count <- if (length(matched)) matched[1] else 0L
      tooltip <- sprintf('%s: %s; %s: %s; %s: %s; %s: %d', L$institution, institution_label, L$instrument, instrument_labels[[site_lang]][instrument], L$selected_period, matrix_periods[period_index], L$documents, count)
      cat(sprintf('<td style="--cell-level:%.3f" title="%s"><span>%d</span></td>', count / maximum, tooltip, count))
    }
    cat('</tr>')
  }
  cat('</tbody></table></div></div>')
}
cat('</div>')
```

## `r L$documents_by_institution`

```{r}
if (nrow(doc_institutions)) {
  institution_counts <- aggregate(document_id ~ institution, doc_institutions, length)
  names(institution_counts)[2] <- "count"
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(institution_counts, ggplot2::aes(reorder(institution, count), count, text = paste0(L$institution, ": ", institution, "<br>", L$documents, ": ", count))) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = navy, width = 0.68) + ggplot2::coord_flip() + ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = L$documents) + plot_theme
  interactive_plot(p)
} else empty_note(L$no_institutions)
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Period controls swap precomputed matrices; corpus-description charts remain
// readable without JavaScript and are collapsed only after enhancement.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-analytical-lenses]').forEach(component => {
    const tabs = [...component.querySelectorAll('.lens-tabs > [role="tab"]')];
    const panels = [...component.querySelectorAll(':scope > .lens-panel')];
    const refreshSpatialPanel = panel => {
      const periodPanel = panel?.querySelector('[data-spatial-period-panel]:not([hidden])');
      const svg = periodPanel?.querySelector('.spatial-schematic');
      if (!svg) return;
      const width = Math.max(periodPanel.clientWidth, 1);
      svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 900 540');
      svg.style.height = `${width * 540 / 900}px`;
      svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    };
    const activateTab = (tab, moveFocus = false) => {
      tabs.forEach(candidate => {
        const active = candidate === tab;
        candidate.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
        candidate.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
      });
      const activePanel = panels.find(panel => panel.id === tab.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
      panels.forEach(panel => { panel.hidden = panel !== activePanel; });
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        refreshSpatialPanel(activePanel);
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
      }));
      if (moveFocus) tab.focus();
    };
    tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab));
      tab.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        let targetIndex = null;
        if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'ArrowDown') targetIndex = (index + 1) % tabs.length;
        if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowUp') targetIndex = (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        if (event.key === 'Home') targetIndex = 0;
        if (event.key === 'End') targetIndex = tabs.length - 1;
        if (targetIndex !== null) {
          event.preventDefault();
          activateTab(tabs[targetIndex], true);
        } else if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          activateTab(tab, true);
        }
      });
    });
  });

  const setSpatialFilter = target => {
    const rawIds = target?.dataset.spatialDocuments ?? null;
    window.corpusSpatialDocumentIds = rawIds === null
      ? null
      : new Set(rawIds.split('|').filter(Boolean));
    const constellation = target?.closest('[data-spatial-constellation]') ?? document.querySelector('[data-spatial-constellation]');
    const status = constellation?.querySelector('[data-spatial-selection]');
    if (status && target) status.textContent = target.dataset.spatialInfo;
    constellation?.querySelectorAll('[data-spatial-filter]').forEach(candidate => {
      candidate.classList.toggle('is-selected', candidate === target);
      candidate.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(candidate === target));
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('corpus-spatial-filter'));
  };
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-spatial-constellation]').forEach(constellation => {
    const selector = constellation.querySelector('[data-spatial-period]');
    const panels = [...constellation.querySelectorAll('[data-spatial-period-panel]')];
    const reset = constellation.querySelector('[data-spatial-reset]');
    const defaultStatus = constellation.querySelector('[data-spatial-selection]')?.textContent;
    selector?.addEventListener('change', () => {
      panels.forEach(panel => { panel.hidden = panel.id !== selector.value; });
      setSpatialFilter(null);
      const status = constellation.querySelector('[data-spatial-selection]');
      if (status) status.textContent = defaultStatus;
    });
    constellation.querySelectorAll('[data-spatial-filter]').forEach(target => {
      target.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      target.addEventListener('click', () => setSpatialFilter(target));
      if (target.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'g') {
        target.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
          if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
          event.preventDefault();
          setSpatialFilter(target);
        });
      }
    });
    reset?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setSpatialFilter(null);
      const status = constellation.querySelector('[data-spatial-selection]');
      if (status) status.textContent = defaultStatus;
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-instrument-matrix]').forEach(matrix => {
    const selector = matrix.querySelector('[data-matrix-period]');
    const panels = [...matrix.querySelectorAll('.instrument-matrix-panel')];
    selector?.addEventListener('change', () => {
      panels.forEach(panel => { panel.hidden = panel.id !== selector.value; });
    });
  });
  const toggle = document.querySelector('[data-about-corpus-toggle]');
  const content = document.querySelector('#about-corpus-content');
  if (toggle && content) {
    content.hidden = true;
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', toggle.textContent);
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const expanded = toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
      content.hidden = expanded;
    });
  }
});
</script>
```

```{r results='asis'}
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
collapse_unique <- function(x, transform = identity) {
  x <- transform(x[present(x)])
  paste(unique(x), collapse = " | ")
}

if (nrow(docs)) {
  docs$.display_id <- docs$document_id
  missing_id <- !present(docs$.display_id)
  docs$.display_id[missing_id] <- paste0("row-", which(missing_id))
  logical_ids <- unique(docs$.display_id)

  filters <- list(
    year = sort(unique(docs$year[!is.na(docs$year)])),
    institution = sort(unique(docs$institution[present(docs$institution)])),
    family = sort(unique(fam$value)),
    concept = sort(unique(con$value))
  )
  cat('<div class="document-tools" data-document-explorer-controls>')
  cat(sprintf('<label class="search-field"><span>%s</span><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="%s" class="form-control"></label>', L$search_documents, L$search_placeholder))
  cat('<div class="filter-row">')
  for (nm in names(filters)) {
    options <- paste(sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', esc(filters[[nm]]), esc(label_text(filters[[nm]]))), collapse = "")
    cat(sprintf('<label><span>%s</span><select id="f-%s" class="form-select"><option value="">%s</option>%s</select></label>', L$filter[[nm]], nm, L$all, options))
  }
  cat('</div></div>')
  headers <- c(L$year, L$title, L$institution, L$family, L$document_type, L$concepts, L$format, L$publication_modification, L$official_links)
  cat(sprintf('<div class="table-responsive corpus-table-wrap"><table id="corpus-table" class="table"><thead><tr>%s</tr></thead>', paste(sprintf('<th>%s</th>', headers), collapse = "")))
  for (id in logical_ids) {
    d <- docs[docs$.display_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
    year <- if (any(!is.na(d$year))) as.character(d$year[which(!is.na(d$year))[1]]) else "—"
    institution <- collapse_unique(d$institution)
    family_raw <- collapse_unique(d$families)
    family <- collapse_unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(d$families[present(d$families)], collapse = "|"), "\\|")), label_text)
    type <- collapse_unique(d$document_type, label_text)
    confirmed_values <- d$matched_concepts[d$concept_coding_state == "confirmed" & present(d$matched_concepts)]
    concept_values <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(paste(confirmed_values, collapse = "|"), "\\|"))))
    concept_values <- concept_values[nzchar(concept_values)]
    concepts <- paste(label_text(concept_values), collapse = " | ")
    preferred_title <- d$title[present(d$language) & tolower(d$language) == site_lang & present(d$title)]
    if (!length(preferred_title)) preferred_title <- d$title[present(d$title)]
    title <- if (length(preferred_title)) preferred_title[1] else L$untitled
    all_titles <- paste(d$title[present(d$title)], collapse = " | ")
    formats <- collapse_unique(d$format)
    publication_dates <- unique(d$publication_date[present(d$publication_date)])
    modification_dates <- unique(d$page_last_modified[present(d$page_last_modified)])
    title_row <- if (length(preferred_title)) which(d$title == preferred_title[1] & present(d$title))[1] else NA_integer_
    shared_publication <- if (length(publication_dates) == 1) publication_dates else if (!is.na(title_row) && present(d$publication_date[title_row])) d$publication_date[title_row] else if (length(publication_dates)) publication_dates[1] else character()
    shared_modification <- if (!length(shared_publication) && length(modification_dates) == 1) modification_dates else if (!length(shared_publication) && !is.na(title_row) && present(d$page_last_modified[title_row])) d$page_last_modified[title_row] else character()
    date_parts <- c(if (length(shared_publication)) paste0(L$published, " ", shared_publication), if (length(shared_modification)) paste0(L$modified, " ", shared_modification))
    date_text <- if (length(date_parts)) paste(esc(date_parts), collapse = "<br>") else "—"
    links <- character(nrow(d))
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
      language <- if (!present(d$language[j])) L$official_text else if (tolower(d$language[j]) == "en") L$official_english else if (tolower(d$language[j]) == "fr") L$official_french else paste0(label_text(d$language[j]), " ↗")
      aria <- if (!present(d$language[j])) L$official_text_aria else if (tolower(d$language[j]) == "en") L$official_english_aria else if (tolower(d$language[j]) == "fr") L$official_french_aria else paste0(label_text(d$language[j]), if (site_lang == "fr") " (s’ouvre dans un nouvel onglet)" else " (opens in a new tab)")
      links[j] <- if (present(d$document_url[j])) sprintf('<a href="%s" class="official-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="%s">%s</a>', esc(d$document_url[j]), esc(aria), esc(language)) else ""
    }
    search_text <- paste(all_titles, institution, family, type, concepts, formats, collapse = " ")
    cat(sprintf('<tbody class="document-group" data-document-id="%s" data-year="%s" data-institution="%s" data-family="%s" data-concept="%s" data-search="%s"><tr><td>%s</td><td class="document-title">%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td class="official-links">%s</td></tr>',
      esc(id), esc(year), esc(institution), esc(family_raw), esc(paste(concept_values, collapse = "|")), esc(search_text), esc(year), esc(title), esc(institution), esc(family), esc(type), esc(concepts), esc(if (nzchar(formats)) formats else "—"), date_text, paste(links[nzchar(links)], collapse = " ")))
    cat('</tbody>')
  }
  cat(sprintf('</table><p id="no-results" class="empty-state" hidden>%s</p></div>', L$no_matches))
} else empty_note(L$empty_corpus)
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Client-side filtering expects one tbody.document-group per logical document
// and select IDs prefixed with f-. Hidden groups remain in the accessible table.
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const table = document.querySelector('#corpus-table');
  if (!table) return;
  const explorerControls = document.querySelector('[data-document-explorer-controls]');
  const controls = [...(explorerControls?.querySelectorAll('#q, [id^="f-"]') || [])];
  const filterSelects = controls.filter(control => control.matches('select[id^="f-"]'));
  const groups = [...table.querySelectorAll('tbody.document-group')];
  const noResults = document.querySelector('#no-results');
  window.corpusSpatialDocumentIds = null;
  const apply = () => {
    const query = (document.querySelector('#q')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    let visible = 0;
    groups.forEach(group => {
      let show = `${group.textContent} ${group.dataset.search || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      const spatialIds = window.corpusSpatialDocumentIds;
      if (spatialIds !== null && spatialIds !== undefined) {
        show = show && spatialIds.has(group.dataset.documentId);
      }
      filterSelects.forEach(select => {
        if (!select.value) return;
        const key = select.id.slice(2);
        const values = (group.dataset[key] || '').split('|').map(value => value.trim().toLowerCase());
        show = show && values.includes(select.value.toLowerCase());
      });
      group.hidden = !show;
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    if (noResults) noResults.hidden = visible > 0;
  };
  controls.forEach(control => control.addEventListener('input', apply));
  window.addEventListener('corpus-spatial-filter', apply);
  apply();
});
</script>
```
